description: Curated openCypher TCK-style read-only scenarios that Coral claims for virtual graph execution. These scenarios are synthetic and run end-to-end through Cypher parsing, graph validation, SQL lowering, DataFusion execution, and result comparison.

scenarios.query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age >= 30 AND p.active = true RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city IN ['London', 'Paris'] RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.age < 30 OR p.city = 'Paris' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT p.active RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name STARTS WITH 'A' OR p.name CONTAINS 'ar' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name =~ 'A.*' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.active XOR p.city = 'Paris' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 'Person' IN labels(p) AND NOT ('Service' IN labels(p)) RETURN count(p) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 'city' IN keys(p) AND NOT ('missing' IN keys(p)) RETURN count(p) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE exists(p.city) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WHERE p.age < friend.age RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (a:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE r.since >= 2021 RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, r.since AS since ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (target:Person)<-[:KNOWS]-(source:Person) RETURN source.name AS source, target.name AS target ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WITH p, friend WHERE friend IS NULL RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, coalesce(friend.name, 'none') AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, count(friend) AS friend_count ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(p) AS people, sum(p.age) AS age_sum, min(p.age) AS youngest, max(p.age) AS oldest
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(({kind: 'person'}).kind) AS literal_count, sum(({age: p.age + 1}).age) AS adjusted_age, min(({age: p.age}).age) AS youngest
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(DISTINCT p.city) AS city_count
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN count(*) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN avg(p.age) AS average_age, median(p.age) AS median_age, stDev(p.age) AS sample_age_stdev, stDevP(p.age) AS population_age_stdev
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN percentileCont(p.age, 0.75) AS p75_age
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name <> 'Alice' RETURN stDevP(DISTINCT toFloat(p.age)) AS population_age_stdev
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.active AS active ORDER BY count(*) DESC, active
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WITH p.name AS person, count(friend) AS friend_count WHERE friend_count > 1 RETURN person, friend_count
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) } AS friend_count ORDER BY friend_count DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN friend.name } AS friend_count ORDER BY friend_count DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } AS active_states ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY COUNT { MATCH (other:Person) WHERE other.active = p.active RETURN DISTINCT other.city } DESC, person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) } > 1 RETURN p.name AS person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } > 1 RETURN p.name AS person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 1 < COUNT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.active } RETURN p.name AS person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE COUNT { MATCH (other:Person) WHERE other.active = p.active RETURN DISTINCT other.city } > 1 RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE 1 < COUNT { MATCH (other:Person) WHERE other.active = p.active RETURN DISTINCT other.city } RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Bob', 'Carol'] RETURN p.name AS person, COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN friend.name } AS friend_names ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN COLLECT { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) RETURN DISTINCT 'friend' } AS friend_markers
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person) } RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN DISTINCT friend.name } RETURN p.name AS person ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(foaf:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, coalesce(foaf.name, 'none') AS friend_of_friend ORDER BY person, friend_of_friend
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, CASE WHEN p.active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS status ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, 'person' AS kind, 42 AS answer, 1.5 AS score, true AS literal_flag, null AS missing ORDER BY name LIMIT 1
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [1, 2, 3] AS ints, ['a', 'b'] AS strings, [true, false] AS flags
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE coalesce(null, 'prod') = 'prod' AND null IS NULL AND nullIf('prod', 'prod') IS NULL RETURN count(p) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE coalesce(nullIf(p.city, ''), 'missing') = 'missing' RETURN p.name AS name, coalesce(nullIf(p.city, ''), 'missing') AS normalized_city
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE null = null RETURN p.name AS name

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN keys({name: p.name, age: p.age}) AS map_keys, head(keys({first: 1, second: 2})) AS first_key, 'city' IN keys({city: p.city, active: p.active}) AS has_city_key
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE ({active: true}).active = p.active RETURN ({name: 'static'}).name AS dotted, {rank: 7}['rank'] AS indexed, {known: true}.missing AS missing ORDER BY {sort: 'constant'}['sort']

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE {active: p.active}['active'] = true RETURN ({name: p.name}).name AS name, {city: p.city}['city'] AS city, ({upper_city: toUpper(p.city)}).upper_city AS upper_city ORDER BY ({sort: p.age}).sort DESC
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE properties(p).active = true RETURN properties(p).name AS name, properties(p).city AS city ORDER BY properties(p).age DESC
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p['active'] = true RETURN p['name'] AS name, properties(p)['city'] AS city ORDER BY p['age'] DESC
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN range(1, 3) AS numbers, split('red,blue', ',') AS colors, size(range(1, 3)) AS number_count

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN ['a', 'b', 'c'][1] AS second, ['a', 'b', 'c'][0..2] AS first_two, head(['a', 'b']) AS first, last(['a', 'b']) AS last_value, tail(['a', 'b', 'c']) AS tail_values
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE all(x IN [1, 2, 3] WHERE x > 0) AND any(city IN ['London', 'Rome'] WHERE city = 'London') AND p.city = 'London' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [1, 2, 3] WHERE x > 1 | x + 1] AS incremented, [city IN split('London,Paris', ',') | toUpper(city)] AS city_codes
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [1, 2, null] | pow(x, 2)] AS powers, [x IN [2, 3] | power(x, 2)] AS squares

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [0, 1, null] | round(exp(x), 0)] AS exponentials, [x IN [1.0, 2.718281828459045, null] | round(ln(x), 0)] AS natural_logs, [x IN [1, 100, null] | log10(x)] AS base10_logs, [x IN [1, 2] | round(pi(), x)] AS rounded_pi, [x IN [1, 2] | round(e(), x)] AS rounded_e

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN [x IN [0.0, 1.5707963267948966] | round(sin(x), 0)] AS sines, [x IN [0.0, 1.5707963267948966] | round(cos(x), 0)] AS cosines, [x IN [1.0] | round(atan2(x, x), 2)] AS arctangent_pairs, [x IN [3.141592653589793] | round(degrees(x), 0)] AS degree_values, [x IN [180.0] | round(radians(x), 2)] AS radian_values, [x IN [0.0] | haversin(x)] AS haversines

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Bob', 'Carol'] OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, [k IN coalesce(keys(friend), ['fallback', 'unused'])[0..1] | toUpper(k)] AS first_friend_key, [k IN (CASE WHEN friend IS NULL THEN ['fallback', 'unused'] ELSE keys(friend) END)[1..3] | k] AS middle_friend_keys ORDER BY person

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Bob', 'Carol'] OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, [k IN coalesce(keys(friend), ['fallback', 'unused'])[0..1] | k] = ['active'] AS first_key_is_active, 'city' IN [k IN (CASE WHEN friend IS NULL THEN ['fallback', 'unused'] ELSE keys(friend) END)[1..3] | k] AS middle_keys_include_city ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN reduce(total = 0, x IN range(1, 3) | total + x) AS total, reduce(found = false, city IN ['Paris', 'London'] | found OR city = 'London') AS city_seen
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE isEmpty(p.city) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, isEmpty(p.city) AS city_empty ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE toUpper(p.name) = 'ALICE' RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, toLower(p.city) AS city_lower ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, left(p.name, 3) AS name_prefix ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, right(p.city, 2) AS city_suffix ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, contains(p.name, 'ar') AS has_ar, startsWith(p.city, 'L') AS starts_l, endsWith(p.city, 'n') AS ends_n ORDER BY person

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE contains(p.name, 'ar') OR startsWith(p.city, 'L') OR endsWith(p.city, 'n') RETURN p.name AS person, CASE WHEN startsWith(p.city, 'L') THEN 'london' WHEN contains(p.name, 'ar') THEN 'name-match' ELSE 'suffix-match' END AS bucket ORDER BY person
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, trim('  padded  ') AS trimmed, lTrim('  left') AS left_trimmed, rTrim('right  ') AS right_trimmed ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, replace(p.name, 'o', '0') AS replaced, substring(p.name, 1, 2) AS slice, size(p.name) AS name_size ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE reverse(p.name) STARTS WITH 'ecil' OR reverse(p.name) = 'boB' RETURN p.name AS name, reverse(p.city) AS city_reversed ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, abs(p.age - 35) AS d ORDER BY d, name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE ceil(p.age * 0.1) = 4.0 AND floor(p.age * 0.1) = 3.0 AND round(p.age * 0.1, 1) = 3.4 RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE sqrt(abs(p.age - 25)) > 3.0 AND sign(p.age - 34) > 0 RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, round(p.age / 3.0) AS rounded_age_thirds ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, round(p.age / 3.0, 1) AS rounded_age_thirds ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE isEmpty(p.name, p.city) RETURN p.name AS name

expected.contains: isEmpty() supports exactly one scalar string argument

scenarios.query: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN toUpper(p.name, 'extra') AS name_upper
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN left(p.name) AS name_prefix
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN abs() AS d
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN sqrt(p.age, 2) AS root
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN round(p.age, 1, 2) AS rounded_age

expected.contains: round() requires exactly one or two arguments

scenarios.query: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE round(log(exp(1.0)), 2) = 1.0 AND round(log10(100.0), 2) = 2.0 AND round(ln(e()), 2) = 1.0 RETURN count(p) AS people
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE round(sin(radians(90.0)), 2) = 1.0 AND round(cos(0.0), 2) = 1.0 AND round(degrees(atan(1.0)), 0) = 45.0 RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE abs(atan2(1.0, 1.0) - radians(45.0)) < 0.01 AND abs(haversin(radians(180.0)) - 1.0) < 0.01 RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name LIMIT 1
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE pow(toFloat(p.age - 30), 2) > 10 RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY power(toFloat(p.age - 30), 2)
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN pi(1) AS value

MATCH (p:Person) WHERE toFloat(p.age) >= 30.0 AND toInteger(toString(p.age)) >= 30 AND toBoolean(toString(p.active)) = true RETURN p.name AS name, toString(p.age) AS age_text, toBoolean(toString(p.active)) AS active_bool ORDER BY name

MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, coalesce(toStringOrNull(CASE WHEN p.name = 'Bob' THEN null ELSE p.age END), 'missing') AS parsed_age_text, coalesce(toIntegerOrNull(CASE WHEN p.name = 'Bob' THEN 'bad' ELSE toString(p.age) END), -1) AS parsed_age, coalesce(toFloatOrNull(CASE WHEN p.name = 'Bob' THEN 'bad' ELSE toString(p.age) END), -1.0) AS parsed_age_float, coalesce(toBooleanOrNull(CASE WHEN p.name = 'Bob' THEN 'maybe' ELSE toString(p.active) END), false) AS parsed_active ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN toIntegerOrNull(p.age, 10) AS age
MATCH (a:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN id(r) AS relationship_id, type(r) AS relationship_type, a.name AS source, b.name AS target ORDER BY relationship_id
MATCH (:Person)-[r:KNOWS]->(:Person) RETURN startNode(r).name AS source, endNode(r).name AS target, id(startNode(r)) AS source_id, elementId(endNode(r)) AS target_element_id ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN id(p) AS person_id, p.name AS name ORDER BY person_id
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, elementId(p) AS element_id ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name, labels(p)[0] AS label, size(keys(p)) AS key_count ORDER BY name
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY p.age DESC SKIP 1 LIMIT 1
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.name = 'Bob' THEN null ELSE p.age END ASC NULLS LAST
MATCH (p:Person {city: $city}) WHERE p.age IN $ages RETURN p.name AS name ORDER BY name LIMIT $limit
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city = $city RETURN p.name AS name
UNWIND ['London', 'Paris'] AS city MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city = city RETURN city AS city, count(p) AS people ORDER BY city
UNWIND (CASE WHEN true THEN ['London', 'Paris', ''] ELSE ['Berlin'] END)[0..2] AS city MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.city = city RETURN city AS city, p.name AS name ORDER BY city
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN DISTINCT p.city AS city ORDER BY city
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name AS name UNION MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, length(path) AS hops ORDER BY source, target
MATCH (a:Person)-[:KNOWS*2]->(c:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, c.name AS target ORDER BY source, target
MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(c:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, c.name AS target, length(path) AS hops ORDER BY source, target, hops
MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->{1,2}(c:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, c.name AS target, length(path) AS hops ORDER BY source, target, hops
MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS*0..1]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, length(path) AS hops ORDER BY source, target, hops
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) WITH p, friend WHERE friend.age > 30 RETURN p.name AS person, friend.name AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person) WITH p, p.city AS city WHERE city <> '' MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(friend:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, city, friend.name AS friend ORDER BY person, friend
MATCH (p:Person) WITH DISTINCT p.city AS city RETURN city ORDER BY city
MATCH (p:Person) WITH p.name AS person, contains(p.name, 'ar') AS has_ar WHERE has_ar RETURN person, has_ar
MATCH (p:Person) WITH p.name AS name, p.age AS age ORDER BY age DESC SKIP 1 LIMIT 1 RETURN name, age
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name AS name UNION ALL MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name = 'Alice' RETURN p.name AS name
MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, nodes(path) AS nodes, relationships(path) AS relationships ORDER BY source, target

MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) WHERE nodes(path)[0] = id(a) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, nodes(path)[0] AS source_id, nodes(path)[-1] AS target_id, relationships(path)[0] AS relationship_id, head(nodes(path)) AS head_node, last(relationships(path)) AS last_relationship ORDER BY source, target

MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN a.name AS source, b.name AS target, nodes(path)[1..] AS node_tail, relationships(path)[..1] AS relationship_prefix, tail(nodes(path)) AS tail_nodes, reverse(nodes(path)) AS reversed_nodes, reverse(relationships(path)) AS reversed_relationships ORDER BY source, target
MATCH path = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN path
